Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving. … Diego: And who is the man in the blue shirt? … Maya: That is Mr Vega. Look, Mr Vega is showing the way to the sports centre.
